title: Maya Boyd
content:
Maya Simone Boyd (born November 26, 2002) is an American actress. She began her career performing on Broadway while completing her senior year at the University of Michigan in 2023. In August 2026, she was cast to play Ororo Munroe / Storm in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.


== Career ==
Boyd attended the University of Michigan and earned a Bachelor of Fine Arts in musical theatre. She made her Broadway debut her in Merrily We Roll Along and later played Juliet Capulet in the Broadway production of & Juliet. In February 2026 she was cast as Molly Cunningham in August Wilson's Joe Turner's Come and Gone directed by Debbie Allen.
In August 2026, it was announced that Boyd had been cast to play Ororo Munroe / Storm in an untitled X-Men reboot, which has a planned 2028 release,  her feature film debut.
